Label: Label
Comment: A data type representing a bounding box.

Label: ContentExtractionEnumeration
Comment: Specifies which content to extract from a file. One of "all", "lines", or "lineNumbers".

Label: DataSource
Comment: A source of data, optionally transformed before being used.

Label: DataType
Comment: The data type of values expected for a Field in a RecordSet. This class is inspired by the Datatype class in CSVW. In addition to simple atomic types, types can be semantic types, such as schema.org classes, as well types defined in other vocabularies.

Label: Extract
Comment: Specifies how to extract data from a DataSource. The extraction mechanism depends on the type of content, e.g., a column name for tabular data, or a jsonPath for JSON data.

Label: Field
Comment: A component of the structure of a RecordSet, such as a column of a table.

Label: FileObject
Comment: An individual file that is part of a dataset.

Label: FilePropertyEnumeration
Comment: Specifies a property of a FileObject. One of "fullPath" or "fileName".

Label: FileSet
Comment: A set of homogeneous files extracted from a container, optionally filtered by inclusion and/or exclusion filters.

Label: Format
Comment: Specifies how to parse the format of the data from a string representation. For example, format may hold a date format string, a number format, or a bounding box format.

Label: RecordSet
Comment: A description of a set of structured records from one or more data sources and their structure, expressed as a set of fields.

Label: SegmentationMask
Comment: A data type representing a segmentation mask.

Label: Split
Comment: Splits for training a machine learning, typically test, train and validation.

Label: Transform
Comment: Specifies how to transform data extracted from a DataSource. The type of transformation depends on the type of content, e.g., a regular expression to appy on text, or a jsonQuery to transform JSON content.
